encode_video: encode a video tensor with audio to an MP4 file using PyAV and libx264
encode_hdr_tensor_to_mp4: encode a linear HDR tensor to an SDR MP4 with configurable tone mapping
prepare_audio_stream: prepare an AAC audio stream for writing into a PyAV container
resample_audio: resample an audio frame to match the encoder's target format and sample rate
write_audio: write stereo audio samples from a torch tensor into a PyAV container as AAC
